params.name: presetType
params.description: Set the type of statistics to return for each user session.

params.name: userAccount
params.description: Filter sessions by user account, provided in the Domain\username format.

params.name: userName
params.description: Filter sessions by user display name (partial match, e.g. 'John Doe'). If both userName and userAccount are provided, userAccount takes precedence.

params.name: serverName
params.description: Filter sessions by server name. This parameter is only applicable when the preset is set to LIST.

params.name: _timeFrom
params.description: Start date and time of the search period in the format: YYYY-MM-DD'T'hh:mm:ss.sssZ

params.name: _timeTo
params.description: End date and time of the search period in the format: YYYY-MM-DD'T'hh:mm:ss.sssZ

params.name: logonDurationgt
params.description: Minimum logon duration in seconds

params.name: logonDurationlt
params.description: Maximum logon duration in seconds

params.name: _page
params.description: The page number returned. The first page is 1.

params.name: _limit
params.description: The number of items returned per page. Minimum is 1.

items.docs: Returns statistics for all user sessions. Visit the Session Activity Report documentation for column descriptions and more details.

params.name: sessionUid
params.description: Session UID to get timeline for

items.docs: Returns the timeline of session state changes for a specific session.

params.name: machineName
params.description: The name of virtual machine.

params.name: computerId
params.description: The name of virtual machine.

params.name: sessionUid
params.description: Session uid used to identify a session. This value is returned in the session statistics.

params.name: isNormalLogoff
params.description: Was logoff explicit.

params.name: sessionStartDateTime
params.description: Start datetime of requested session details.

params.name: sessionEndDateTime
params.description: End datetime of requested session details.

params.name: _page
params.description: The page number returned. The first page is 1.

params.name: _limit
params.description: The number of items returned per page. Minimum is 1.

items.docs: Returns activity details of individual session. Visit the Session Activity Report documentation for column descriptions and more details.

params.name: groupBy
params.description: Single session dimension to group rows by.

params.name: metrics
params.description: One or more session metrics to aggregate. Repeat the parameter for multiple values.

params.name: aggregations
params.description: Aggregation functions to apply to each metric. Repeat for multiple. Default: avg.

params.name: _sortBy
params.description: Response field to sort by (must equal a returned <metric>_<aggregation>, session_count, or the groupBy field). Default: <first metric>_<first aggregation>.

params.name: _sortOrder
params.description: Sort order. Default: desc.

params.name: _timeFrom
params.description: Start date and time of the search period in the format: YYYY-MM-DD'T'hh:mm:ss.sssZ

params.name: _timeTo
params.description: End date and time of the search period in the format: YYYY-MM-DD'T'hh:mm:ss.sssZ

params.name: userAccount
params.description: Filter sessions by user account, provided in the Domain\username format.

params.name: serverName
params.description: Filter sessions by server name.

params.name: logonDurationgt
params.description: Minimum logon duration in seconds (pre-aggregation filter).

params.name: logonDurationlt
params.description: Maximum logon duration in seconds (pre-aggregation filter).

params.name: _page
params.description: The page number returned. The first page is 1.

params.name: _limit
params.description: The number of items returned per page. Minimum is 1.

items.docs: Returns aggregated session activity metrics (avg/min/max/count) grouped by a single session dimension such as folder, delivery group, site, user, protocol, or initial program. Visit the Session Activity Report documentation for column descriptions and more details.
